reachability.publicOperations: EIP-712 recovery uses k256 VerifyingKey::recover_from_prehash; ES256 uses p256 VerifyingKey::verify. Approved signer keys/addresses and funded context are public or committed configuration. No engine EC signing key or ECDH operation was found in these production call sites.
reachability.secretOperations: No secret scalar signing/decryption path demonstrated. However signature verification hashes the supplied evidence payload; evidence bytes and intermediate hashes may be private witness data. Calling an operation verification does not make all operands public. The random delivery-encryption key is passed to protocol encryption/key commitment, not to EC arithmetic in the reviewed code.
unknowns: Which 0.5.5 arithmetic operations are emitted and exercised by each signature profile on the pinned host and zkVM toolchains.
Whether a practical observer can correlate timing, cycles or microarchitectural behavior with private evidence; no side-channel measurement or binary analysis was performed.
Alloy signer code presence is not evidence the CLI signs; future signer features would require a fresh secret-key review.

mitigations: Keep production signing/private-scalar operations out of this dependency path until reviewed.
Use synthetic evidence for integration; isolate proving workloads from untrusted co-tenants and do not expose fine-grained witness timing as a confidentiality guarantee.
Maintain input/resource bounds; these do not fix timing variability.

mitigations: Do not introduce panicking key destructors or resume cache use after a panic; restart the process instead.
Prefer avoiding unused provider/cache features if upstream supports that without changing seal behavior.

compatibilityGates.owner: Anish coordinates engine/toolchain; Nick approves settlement verifier/image allowlist changes; Neil updates commerce package/worker integration
compatibilityGates.policy: No dependency or lockfile change in this task. Remediation is a separately reviewed, bounded change, not approval to upgrade the entire proof stack.
requiredBeforeAdoptingRemediation: Capture exact old/new dependency graphs, features, Cargo checksums, MSRV, Rust/RISC-V toolchain and Docker digest. Rescan every host and published guest lock, including duplicate versions.

Rebuild all affected generated checker packages reproducibly with pinned source and lockfiles. Compare guest ELF/image IDs and structure/rules/reference commitments. Unchanged thresholds alone do not imply unchanged dependency-derived images.

If image changes, publish a new package/manifest and new real pass/fail receipts; retain historical artifacts unchanged. Existing funded jobs pin the old image and cannot silently adopt a rebuilt checker. Obtain explicit new-term approval rather than relabeling old receipts.

Rerun all six signature profile positives and invalid-signature negatives, context/replay/envelope/key mutations, byte-exact recovery, deterministic engine tests, SDK wire/ABI and receipt verification checks. Measure cycles and proof latency for expiry budgets.

Preserve or explicitly revalidate RISC Zero 3.1.0, r0vm 3.1.0, the compiler/guest toolchain and Groth16 container digest. Verify receipt serialization, control root/BN254 control ID, seal selector 0xe71e6620 and 260-byte seal against the pinned Solidity verifier from risc0-ethereum v3.1.0 commit ff30da77ba4afdd496290ebebedb205348b15d83.

Host-only changes do not automatically require new guest proofs if guest source/locks/toolchain/images remain byte-identical; demonstrate that identity and replay existing receipt/seal compatibility. Do not infer verifier replacement merely from a maintenance warning.
If a proof-system/verifier incompatibility is found, stop and seek owner authorization. No live deployment, transaction, freeze or proof pin change is authorized here.

boundedCiFix.rootCause: Pinned @types/node 22.20.5 DecipherChaCha20Poly1305.setAAD overload requires the second options argument with plaintextLength. The fixture omitted it, causing TS2554. ChaCha ciphertext and plaintext lengths are equal, excluding nonce/tag.
boundedCiFix.change: Add { plaintextLength: ciphertext.length }; preserve all fixture bytes and commitments.
boundedCiFix.discovery: SDK Vitest includes only test/**/*.test.ts, so the node:test fixture under src needs an explicit Node invocation. && preserves failure propagation and prevents Vitest from masking fixture failures.

Page at no more than 10000 blocks; preserve complete ordered logs by block, transaction and log index.

Require both final holder sets empty and cross-check every discovered account with hasRole at that same block. Review RoleAdminChanged and upgrade history; unknown implementation provenance or role writes without events invalidates event-only reconstruction.

productionVerdict: Not approved for a blanket production-security claim. Four security/soundness findings and three maintenance warnings have distinct conditional exposure. No proof forgery, private RSA key recovery or practical secret-data timing attack was demonstrated by this review; that is not proof of absence.
